sample.start_rule: profile sample_policy start 2015-01; first usable transformed month 2015-02 (log differences lose one month)
sample.end_cutoff: 2026-06 (latest common observation in the frozen data snapshot)
sample.rule: the effective sample is exactly the production runReducedFormVar effective sample (contiguous common months after transformation) for start 2015-01 and end 2026-06; if the snapshot hash differs at execution time, the audit must not run without a preregistration amendment

transformations: production timeSeriesTransforms.applyTransformation: hicp_monthly_index log_difference, industrial_production_index log_difference, unemployment_rate_monthly level

deterministic_specifications.baseline_monthly_macro_v2_seasonal_contr: constant + 11 month dummies (January omitted in production)

candidate_lag_set: 1..min(12, floor((T_eff-4)/(4K+1))) = 1..10 for T_eff=137, K=3 (production maximumAllowedVarLag); common sample of T_eff - 10 = 127 observations
bic_implementation: production src/lib/varEngine.ts selectVarLagOrder (statsmodels select_order convention), first-minimum tie rule; engine SHA256 frozen
execution_plan: Node stage: rebuild each unit's effective data matrix with the production transformation and runReducedFormVar sample logic, and record the production BIC grid, selected lag, estimates, stability and h=12 Portmanteau from varEngine.ts exported functions.

Python stage: recompute the preregistered metrics from the same matrix and require agreement with production (BIC grid, selected lag, coefficients, residuals, Portmanteau statistic) to 1e-8 before any metric is written.
Phase B (separate owner approval): v1.86 frozen engine bootstrap per var_phase_b_bootstrap_protocol.json.
